description: This file defines an interface named FileInterface within the Goteo\Library\FileHandler namespace. It declares methods for file operations such as connect, close, upload, delete, download, rename, size, mtime, exists, get_contents, put_contents, and others, intended to be implemented by classes handling file storage or transfer.

classes.name: FileInterface
classes.description: An interface specifying a contract for file handling operations such as connecting, uploading, downloading, deleting, and retrieving file information.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establish a connection to the file storage system.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Close the connection to the file storage system.

methods.name: realpath
methods.description: Get the real filesystem path corresponding to a given path.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Upload a local file to a remote destination.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Download a remote file to a local path.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Rename a remote file or directory.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Get the size of a remote file.

methods.name: mtime
methods.description: Get the last modification time of a remote file.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Check if a remote file exists.

methods.name: get_contents
methods.description: Retrieve the contents of a remote file.

methods.name: put_contents
methods.description: Write data to a remote file.

methods.name: get_save_name
methods.description: Get a suitable local filename for saving a remote file.

methods.name: get_public_url
methods.description: Get the public URL for a remote file, given its filename.
